question:
An engineer enters these commands while in EEM on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch: event manager applet Backup-config event timer watchdog time 1800 name timer event cli match "copy running-config startup-config"
What is the result of applying this configuration?
options: It generates an error because no action is mentioned.
It executes the copy running-config startup-config command.
It saves the running configuration every 1800 seconds.
It blocks the copy running-config startup-config command.
theory: EEM requires an explicit 'event-default' action whenever a policy matches a CLI command; without it, EEM intercepts the matched command but does not allow it to actually run. This applet defines an event that matches 'copy running-config startup-config' but never adds an event-default action, so instead of executing (or merely being logged), the command is effectively blocked from completing when a user enters it. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
